question: Which program-identity notes does the retained Linux x86-64 node #115 ELF declare in its SHT_NOTE sections, and what do those pinned bytes constrain for a deterministic source rebuild?
gnu_property_note_basis: The checker selected every section header whose sh_type is 7 (SHT_NOTE) across the 33 recorded sections and found exactly two. No .note.gnu.property section header and no note of type 5 (NT_GNU_PROPERTY_TYPE_0) appears in the recorded output, so no property record is recorded for this target.
observations: The two note sections are the only SHT_NOTE sections in the recorded 33-section table.
Both note sections record flags 0x2 and have file offset equal to virtual address (0x2fc and 0x31c).
.note.ABI-tag holds one note: name GNU, namesz 4, descsz 16, type 1.
.note.gnu.build-id holds one note: name GNU, namesz 4, descsz 20, type 3.
No note of type 5 was observed, so no NT_GNU_PROPERTY_TYPE_0 record is recorded for this target.
inferences: Flags 0x2 is the ELF SHF_ALLOC bit, so both note sections belong to the loaded image.

Note type 1 with the four little-endian words 0, 3, 2, 0 reads as the GNU ABI tag for OS Linux with a minimum kernel of 3.2.0 under the documented NT_GNU_ABI_TAG layout. This is an inference from the recorded descriptor bytes, not an executed check.
Note type 3 with a 20-byte descriptor is NT_GNU_BUILD_ID. Those 20 bytes are link-time output, so an independent rebuild is not expected to reproduce them byte for byte.
build_plan_constraint: A rebuild compared against this target must reproduce the absence of any property note and the Linux 3.2.0 ABI-tag claim. The 20-byte build-id descriptor is a link-time value and is expected to differ unless the entire link is bit-identical.

reproduce.recorded_status: exit 1 while the remaining packet files were absent; the values recorded above are that run's stdout

limits: Static read of two SHT_NOTE sections of artifacts/node/115/hl-node. The target was never executed or copied. No program headers, PT_NOTE segment count, compiler identity, linker flags or .comment records are claimed here, and no byte sequence outside the two note sections was searched. The absence of a property note is bounded to the section headers recorded here.
next_question: Which PT_NOTE program-header segment covers these two note sections, and does any other loaded segment carry a note-shaped record?
